youtube.title: Why Phone and Calculator Keypads Are Flipped 📱 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Phone keypads put 1-2-3 on the top row, while calculators put 7-8-9 there. Calculator layouts descend from mechanical adding machines, where digits stacked upward from the bottom. Bell Labs engineers studied dialing layouts in the 1950s and chose 1-2-3 on top for the touch-tone phone, which matched the way people read.
